status.description: When you are not fully known to CM yet, and have not yet proven to qualify as an iDIN merchant, then you will have the `onboarding` status. In this status, you will only be able to retrieve test data.

identity.description: Retrieve a uniquely identifying token with the bank for this consumer that is consistent across multiple sessions

name.description: Can retrieve the name information associated with this consumer

gender.description: Can retrieve the gender of this consumer

address.description: Can retrieve address information associated with this consumer

date_of_birth.description: Can retrieve the birthdate of the user

18y_or_older.description: Can retrieve if this user is known to be 18 years or older.

email_address.description: Can retrieve the email address associated with this consumer.

telephone_number.description: Can retrieve the telephone number associated with this consumer.

services.description: This lists the services that you are allowed to access per your agreement with CM.

contact.description: Your contact information as it is known to CM

balance.description: Reserved. This will list the credit balance etc.
